giant.en: These are giant sculptures weighing up to 50 tons and possibly represent their rulers.
giant.zh: 这些巨大的雕塑重达50吨，可能代表了他们的统治者。

giant.en: So, it’s true: Clive Davis, the music-industry giant, signed us to Arista Records.
giant.zh: 所以，这是真的：音乐产业巨头克里夫·戴维斯将我们签到了Arista唱片公司。

giant.en: Nobody who's seen giant pandas in a zoo would find them hard to spot.
giant.zh: 任何在动物园里见过大熊猫的人都不会觉得它们很难被发现。

giant.en: And across the island are hundreds of giant stone heads, carved by hand.
giant.zh: 而在这座岛屿的各处，耸立着数百尊由人工雕刻的巨型石像。

giant.en: In this programme, we'll discuss our past and present relationship with these giants of the ocean.
giant.zh: 在这期节目中，我们要聊聊人类与这些海洋巨兽之间过去和现在的关系。

ginger.en: No. Turmeric? No. Ginger shots? No. This is a very, very good quiz!
ginger.zh: 没有。姜黄？没有。生姜汁？没有。这是一个非常非常好的测验！

ginger.en: Spices such as pepper, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, and mace were used extensively in cooking.
ginger.zh: 胡椒、生姜、肉桂、丁香、肉豆蔻和肉豆蔻皮等香料在烹饪中被广泛使用。

ginger.en: This isn’t really true. British cooking historically used loads of spices: black pepper, ginger, nutmeg, cinnamon, cloves, mustard, and mace.
ginger.zh: 这并不完全属实。英国烹饪在历史上使用了大量的香料：黑胡椒、生姜、肉豆蔻、肉桂、丁香、芥末和肉豆蔻皮。

gigantic.en: It was a gigantic territory, greater even than the Roman Empire at its height.
gigantic.zh: 这是一个巨大的领土，甚至比全盛时期的罗马帝国还要大。
